DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: Place 4 vault shards into the core
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: Place 4 vault shards into the core

Message.SourceString: I did have some vault guardians, who had hands at least, but they seem to have expired. It's really rather irritating.
Message.LocalizedString: I did have some vault guardians, who had hands at least, but they seem to have expired. It's really rather irritating.

Message.SourceString: I want you to find my vault guardians and retrieve a Crystal Helix they were carrying. It is the key to a... shortcut which leads directly to Fuzan's Volcano.
Message.LocalizedString: I want you to find my vault guardians and retrieve a Crystal Helix they were carrying. It is the key to a... shortcut which leads directly to Fuzan's Volcano.

Message.SourceString: You seem to be helping Avisk, but you're too clever to REALLY be helping Avisk. You have an angle on this, don't you?
Message.LocalizedString: You seem to be helping Avisk, but you're too clever to REALLY be helping Avisk. You have an angle on this, don't you?

Message.SourceString: I was wondering when you’d show up!
Message.LocalizedString: I was wondering when you’d show up!

Message.SourceString: It is incredibly good to see you, but we have a problem - a problem we need to align on.
Message.LocalizedString: It is incredibly good to see you, but we have a problem - a problem we need to align on.

Message.SourceString: Ah, you found the dismembered vault guardian? Yeah, that was my handiwork. In fact, it's something I would like to discuss...
Message.LocalizedString: Ah, you found the dismembered vault guardian? Yeah, that was my handiwork. In fact, it's something I would like to discuss...

Message.SourceString: Non-designated individual detected.
Message.LocalizedString: Non-designated individual detected.

Message.SourceString: Of course! Avisk wants to diffuse his consciousness to the kalphite and the Kalphite Queen! In what world was that plan going to work, Avisk?
Message.LocalizedString: Of course! Avisk wants to diffuse his consciousness to the kalphite and the Kalphite Queen! In what world was that plan going to work, Avisk?

Message.SourceString: Don't listen to the goblin! Jump into the hole like a good mortal!
Message.LocalizedString: Don't listen to the goblin! Jump into the hole like a good mortal!

Message.SourceString: Pffrt. What do you say we play a bit of whack-a-crystal? Get your pickaxe out.
Message.LocalizedString: Pffrt. What do you say we play a bit of whack-a-crystal? Get your pickaxe out.

Message.SourceString: Non-designated individual detected. Access denied.
Message.LocalizedString: Non-designated individual detected. Access denied.

Message.SourceString: Ha! Like we'd believe that, you goofy carbon deposit! Notice how there's heat coming from the hole? Avisk must want the Crystal Helix melted in the lava or geyser that lies down there.
Message.LocalizedString: Ha! Like we'd believe that, you goofy carbon deposit! Notice how there's heat coming from the hole? Avisk must want the Crystal Helix melted in the lava or geyser that lies down there.

Message.SourceString: A decommissioned Vault Guardian. Very odd.
Message.LocalizedString: A decommissioned Vault Guardian. Very odd.

Message.SourceString: I suppose your mushy mortal mind has forgotten the current objective.
Message.LocalizedString: I suppose your mushy mortal mind has forgotten the current objective.

Message.SourceString: Our paths cross again, mortal! I have need of someone with legs, hands and an impressionable character. While they are common evolutionary traits, I'm lacking them all here in the desert.
Message.LocalizedString: Our paths cross again, mortal! I have need of someone with legs, hands and an impressionable character. While they are common evolutionary traits, I'm lacking them all here in the desert.

Message.SourceString: Crystal Helix fragments detected. You carry them, Vault Guardian Prime.
Message.LocalizedString: Crystal Helix fragments detected. You carry them, Vault Guardian Prime.

Message.SourceString: Deliver fragments to this unit. Unit will then repair the Crystal Helix.
Message.LocalizedString: Deliver fragments to this unit. Unit will then repair the Crystal Helix.

Message.SourceString: Reconstruction complete. Mission… fulfilled.
Message.LocalizedString: Reconstruction complete. Mission… fulfilled.

Message.SourceString: That interests you, yes? You want to confront Fuzan, don't you? Use the Crystal Helix to access a secret entrance in the nearby cave. Help me and we both benefit.
Message.LocalizedString: That interests you, yes? You want to confront Fuzan, don't you? Use the Crystal Helix to access a secret entrance in the nearby cave. Help me and we both benefit.

Message.SourceString: Fragments withheld. Directive cannot be fulfilled. Return when ready.
Message.LocalizedString: Fragments withheld. Directive cannot be fulfilled. Return when ready.

Message.SourceString: Avisk 0, Team Adventurers 1. We should get out of here.
Message.LocalizedString: Avisk 0, Team Adventurers 1. We should get out of here.

Message.SourceString: Unit damaged… systems failing…
Message.LocalizedString: Unit damaged… systems failing…

Message.SourceString: Going by the lack of colour in the crystal, Avisk is no longer home.
Message.LocalizedString: Going by the lack of colour in the crystal, Avisk is no longer home.

Message.SourceString: Er, could you clear out some of the stuff in your inventory? I can't give you the reward with so much in there.
Message.LocalizedString: Er, could you clear out some of the stuff in your inventory? I can't give you the reward with so much in there.

Message.SourceString: Here, have a reward for trusting me over that fancy pebble. I found it in a tunnel that led into this cave. Looks impressive.
Message.LocalizedString: Here, have a reward for trusting me over that fancy pebble. I found it in a tunnel that led into this cave. Looks impressive.

Message.SourceString: All that's left is for me to deal with the giant Avisk crystal on the surface.
Message.LocalizedString: All that's left is for me to deal with the giant Avisk crystal on the surface.

Message.SourceString: Keep working on that Crystal Helix. I'm going to see if there's another way past that magical barrier.
Message.LocalizedString: Keep working on that Crystal Helix. I'm going to see if there's another way past that magical barrier.

Message.SourceString: The vault guardian lies half-buried in the sand, its frame twisted and silent.
Message.LocalizedString: The vault guardian lies half-buried in the sand, its frame twisted and silent.

Message.SourceString: Its energy core flickers weakly. There is space for 4 vault shards in the core. Perhaps they would reactivate it?
Message.LocalizedString: Its energy core flickers weakly. There is space for 4 vault shards in the core. Perhaps they would reactivate it?

Message.SourceString: Auxiliary power… restored…
Message.LocalizedString: Auxiliary power… restored…

Message.SourceString: Crystal Helix... fragment… released…
Message.LocalizedString: Crystal Helix... fragment… released…

Message.SourceString: Its energy core flickers weakly. There is space for 4 vault shards in the core. Perhaps they would reactivate it?
Message.LocalizedString: Its energy core flickers weakly. There is space for 4 vault shards in the core. Perhaps they would reactivate it?

Message.SourceString: The vault shards magnetise into place.
Message.LocalizedString: The vault shards magnetise into place.

Message.SourceString: The vault guardian's core flickers with what seems like sadness.
Message.LocalizedString: The vault guardian's core flickers with what seems like sadness.

Message.SourceString: That should be it! We've undermined his plan to mind-meld with the kalphite and the Kalphite Queen. Who knows what THAT might have been like.
Message.LocalizedString: That should be it! We've undermined his plan to mind-meld with the kalphite and the Kalphite Queen. Who knows what THAT might have been like.

Message.SourceString: The core housing has been pried open. If the Crystal Helix was here, it has been taken.
Message.LocalizedString: The core housing has been pried open. If the Crystal Helix was here, it has been taken.

Message.SourceString: Small footprints lead away from the ruined guardian. They look like they belong to something goblin-sized.
Message.LocalizedString: Small footprints lead away from the ruined guardian. They look like they belong to something goblin-sized.

Message.SourceString: I'd like to suggest an alternative plan. You complete the Crystal Helix, then we access this Shortcut Chamber - whatever it is - and then we undermine whatever Avisk's REAL plan is.
Message.LocalizedString: I'd like to suggest an alternative plan. You complete the Crystal Helix, then we access this Shortcut Chamber - whatever it is - and then we undermine whatever Avisk's REAL plan is.

Message.SourceString: How does that sound? If you're in, you will be needing this...
Message.LocalizedString: How does that sound? If you're in, you will be needing this...

Message.SourceString: You don't have space to take the Crystal Helix fragment.
Message.LocalizedString: You don't have space to take the Crystal Helix fragment.

Message.SourceString: Or, at least, you would if you had space. Make some room and then we can go undercover.
Message.LocalizedString: Or, at least, you would if you had space. Make some room and then we can go undercover.

Message.SourceString: Protocol override. Vault Guardian Prime status will be conferred to new subject. YOU are now Vault Guardian Prime.
Message.LocalizedString: Protocol override. Vault Guardian Prime status will be conferred to new subject. YOU are now Vault Guardian Prime.

Message.SourceString: Kalphite assault… overwhelming. Game over man... Game over...
Message.LocalizedString: Kalphite assault… overwhelming. Game over man... Game over...

Message.SourceString: You don't have space to take the Crystal Helix fragment.
Message.LocalizedString: You don't have space to take the Crystal Helix fragment.

Message.SourceString: Take the Crystal Helix fragment… Complete the task…
Message.LocalizedString: Take the Crystal Helix fragment… Complete the task…

Message.SourceString: The light in its core fades.
Message.LocalizedString: The light in its core fades.

Message.SourceString: A wall of energy blocks the path. The air hums with power.
Message.LocalizedString: A wall of energy blocks the path. The air hums with power.

Message.SourceString: The barrier seemed to scan you for something, then shoved you back once it found it missing.
Message.LocalizedString: The barrier seemed to scan you for something, then shoved you back once it found it missing.

Message.SourceString: Mission handover: the Crystal Helix was… shattered into three fragments.
Message.LocalizedString: Mission handover: the Crystal Helix was… shattered into three fragments.

Message.SourceString: The Crystal Helix spins brightly in your hands. The barrier shifts and matches the light of the Crystal Helix. It allows you to pass.
Message.LocalizedString: The Crystal Helix spins brightly in your hands. The barrier shifts and matches the light of the Crystal Helix. It allows you to pass.

Message.SourceString: The vein within the crystal pops disgustingly.
Message.LocalizedString: The vein within the crystal pops disgustingly.

Message.SourceString: You can't destroy Avisk! I have many places like this - full of my consciousness.
Message.LocalizedString: You can't destroy Avisk! I have many places like this - full of my consciousness.

Message.SourceString: It is a red crystal with a deep glow to it.
Message.LocalizedString: It is a red crystal with a deep glow to it.

Message.SourceString: The vein gushes out horribly.
Message.LocalizedString: The vein gushes out horribly.

Message.SourceString: Perhaps we could work together? You can have Ghornfell. I have no use for Ghornfell.
Message.LocalizedString: Perhaps we could work together? You can have Ghornfell. I have no use for Ghornfell.

Message.SourceString: It is a red crystal with a deep glow to it.
Message.LocalizedString: It is a red crystal with a deep glow to it.

Message.SourceString: The chamber shakes as you throttle the vein.
Message.LocalizedString: The chamber shakes as you throttle the vein.

Message.SourceString: Three vault guardians are in possession of them. Recover the fragments… and this unit can restore the Crystal Helix. Then... magical barrier will open.
Message.LocalizedString: Three vault guardians are in possession of them. Recover the fragments… and this unit can restore the Crystal Helix. Then... magical barrier will open.

Message.SourceString: Must I be humiliated? Why am I always the one who is shamed?
Message.LocalizedString: Must I be humiliated? Why am I always the one who is shamed?

Message.SourceString: It is a red crystal with a deep glow to it.
Message.LocalizedString: It is a red crystal with a deep glow to it.

Message.SourceString: You yank the vein out of the pedestal.
Message.LocalizedString: You yank the vein out of the pedestal.

Message.SourceString: Don't think that this is the end. We will meet again, puny human.
Message.LocalizedString: Don't think that this is the end. We will meet again, puny human.

Message.SourceString: It is a red crystal with a deep glow to it.
Message.LocalizedString: It is a red crystal with a deep glow to it.

Message.SourceString: Avisk is everywhere, mortals! Adventurerer, complete your quest. All that remains is for you to jump into the hole with the Crystal Helix. It will take you directly to Fuzan!
Message.LocalizedString: Avisk is everywhere, mortals! Adventurerer, complete your quest. All that remains is for you to jump into the hole with the Crystal Helix. It will take you directly to Fuzan!

Message.SourceString: Crystal Helix remains incomplete.
Message.LocalizedString: Crystal Helix remains incomplete.

Message.SourceString: One lies buried… outside... within a ruin of some kind.
Message.LocalizedString: One lies buried… outside... within a ruin of some kind.

Message.SourceString: One was captured... in this cave. An obstruction pins the unit in place.
Message.LocalizedString: One was captured... in this cave. An obstruction pins the unit in place.

Message.SourceString: The vault guardian lies shattered, its frame torn apart. Deep score marks cut through the plating.
Message.LocalizedString: The vault guardian lies shattered, its frame torn apart. Deep score marks cut through the plating.

Message.SourceString: The last rests near some eggs of the kalphite... on the surface...
Message.LocalizedString: The last rests near some eggs of the kalphite... on the surface...

Message.SourceString: Find my defunct vault guardians, gather fragments of the Crystal Helix, and use them together to open up a shortcut to Fuzan in the cave back there.
Message.LocalizedString: Find my defunct vault guardians, gather fragments of the Crystal Helix, and use them together to open up a shortcut to Fuzan in the cave back there.

Message.SourceString: What are you waiting for? You have the Crystal Helix. Go into the Kalphite Hive, pass the magical barrier, and meet your doo... victory!
Message.LocalizedString: What are you waiting for? You have the Crystal Helix. Go into the Kalphite Hive, pass the magical barrier, and meet your doo... victory!

Message.SourceString: Phew! Definitely took the harder route into this cave. Wait a minute - are those crystals the same as the one outside?
Message.LocalizedString: Phew! Definitely took the harder route into this cave. Wait a minute - are those crystals the same as the one outside?

Message.SourceString: My objective is complete. I can rest now.
Message.LocalizedString: My objective is complete. I can rest now.

Message.SourceString: Carry on the mission... Use the Crystal Helix to pass through the magical barrier.
Message.LocalizedString: Carry on the mission... Use the Crystal Helix to pass through the magical barrier.

Message.SourceString: You better believe something is off! Avisk has zero interest in finding a shortcut to Fuzan. It's a big old stinking ruse.
Message.LocalizedString: You better believe something is off! Avisk has zero interest in finding a shortcut to Fuzan. It's a big old stinking ruse.

Message.SourceString: Ooh, very clandestine! Keep your friends close and your enemies closer, right? Close enough to put them in a headlock.
Message.LocalizedString: Ooh, very clandestine! Keep your friends close and your enemies closer, right? Close enough to put them in a headlock.

Message.SourceString: Thanks for helping with that dragonkin buffoon. I slipped a dagger into the vein of consciousness within his crystal. It's only a setback for him, as he will have other crystals for his mind to retreat into.
Message.LocalizedString: Thanks for helping with that dragonkin buffoon. I slipped a dagger into the vein of consciousness within his crystal. It's only a setback for him, as he will have other crystals for his mind to retreat into.

Message.SourceString: You made it into the Umbral Sands! It was never in doubt. I'm a little busy now, but shall we catch up later?
Message.LocalizedString: You made it into the Umbral Sands! It was never in doubt. I'm a little busy now, but shall we catch up later?
